On 2026-10-22 the maintainer widened it into a renovation program (D-WORKFLOW-181, on `feature/m6-renovation-plan-346` until merged): modernize, standards and best practices, bugs, package currency, efficiency (computation, memory, the player's time), dead ends, clarity and structure. Still in slices, progressively, beside feature work, never one broad sweep. Fable plans; a model such as Opus 5.5 executes a slice from its brief. Planning, the division of work, the definition of work items and every roadmap change stay in the coordinator lane; a work lane executes and does not plan (D-WORKFLOW-189, 2026-10-23). The plan for the plan is `docs/reviews/plan-for-the-plan.md` (#346).

**Acceptance.** Every slice `docs/reviews/order.md` names has its audit folder under `docs/audits/` with the review depth its issue recorded, `tools/lint-audit-artifacts` PASS, and a punch-list issue whose items are resolved through Phase 7 or accepted by a register row; no release waits on the renovation: a finding that is a defect is a bug issue and holds or clears a release as every bug does (D-WORKFLOW-187, refining D-WORKFLOW-102). body:
The punch list of the M6 T24 audit (#671): the emulator recipes and files that no shipped image builds. That is 86 paths, 2,399 lines, all upstream-carried: 81 LibreELEC files under `packages/emulation/` and 5 ROCKNIX recipes. Read at `8ebaf8daad`; `reviewed-at: 81331b499e` (its bytes on the 86 equal the hash's). Depth **Local** (D-WORKFLOW-184): no reviewer.

**Folder:** [`docs/audits/2026_10_24-epic-m6-emulators-dead-ends/`](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/feature/m6-emulators-dead-ends-671/docs/audits/2026_10_24-epic-m6-emulators-dead-ends) on `feature/m6-emulators-dead-ends-671` at `5bfc8601e0`. The punch list is `05-punch-list.md`.

## Executive summary

**No image we build reaches any of the 86.** Each row was read four ways, with `snes9x-lr` as the control beside every zero:
- the three shipped plans (`tools/viewplan`, narrow and wide);
- the metapackage;
- every `PKG_DEPENDS*` edge;
- the five M7 roots' build directories.

Every row is `kept: upstream's`, with an `Already written:` line, and nothing is deleted, moved or edited.
- **The 81** are Kodi's RetroPlayer set. Their only build edges come from 78 Kodi addon recipes, which are unreached too. LibreELEC master already differs from our copy in 67 of the 80 recipes, so each import re-touches them.
- **The twin map:** 67 of the 77 cores have a ROCKNIX `*-lr` twin, and 10 have none.
- **The five:** two are built only by ROCKNIX's AMD64 image, and three by no ROCKNIX configuration.

**No defect, no `bug`.** `pkgcheck` passes all 85 recipes under both copies, and every primary URL's repository answers. The HEAD probe cannot see a dead commit; that limit is recorded in P15.

## Acceptance-criteria scorecard (#671, at stage D)

- **Met:** 1, 3, 6 to 11 (17 = 17), and 12's `question:` half. The lint prints `PASS pre-issue artifacts`, with the D-WORKFLOW-184 line.
- **Open for later stages:** 2 (resolution), 4, 5, 12's diff at `fixed-at`, 13, and 14.

## The items

Each checkbox is ticked from its acceptance artifact once its Phase 7 outcome is recorded in `05-punch-list.md`: resolved with its commit, deferred to a named issue, or withdrawn with its reason.

- [x] **PL-01** (Low, Q6, Renovation, F-01): **the #585 proposal for the 81 LibreELEC files.** Acceptance: #585 carries the coordinator's proposal with the counts of `05` § PL-01 and a link to `04` § Q6 and § Q7. `git diff --diff-filter=DR --name-only 8ebaf8daad <fixed-at> -- packages/emulation` prints nothing.
  - The counts: 81 files, 2,258 lines, 86,663 bytes (97 files and 106,103 bytes with T40's 16 patches). 67 of 80 recipes differ at LibreELEC master. 67 twins, and 10 cores with none.
- [x] **PL-02** (Low, Q6, Renovation, F-02): **the five ROCKNIX recipes no shipped device builds, said once with T3 cited.** Acceptance: the five `projects/` rows of `04` § Q6 read `kept: upstream's; no shipped device builds it`; `git diff --name-only 8ebaf8daad <fixed-at> -- projects/ROCKNIX/packages/emulators/libretro` prints nothing; the Phase 7 gate records `deferred:#585` or `withdrawn` with the reason.
  - `boom3-lr` and `vitaquake3-lr` are built only by `idtech-lr`'s `x86_64` arm, which means AMD64. `mame2003-lr`, `panda3ds-lr` and `play-lr` have no build edge at all.
- [x] **PL-03** (Low, Q6, Renovation, F-03): **every shipped image's `/usr/share/rocknix/core-pins` names `boom3-lr` and `vitaquake3-lr`, which the image does not hold.** The cause is `virtual/emulators/package.mk:1768`, a fork-own line in T3's file. Its one reader, `cloud_capture:121`, looks up the core that ran, so nothing fails. Acceptance: the Phase 7 gate records the coordinator's disposition, either a stream whose proof is the three images' `core-pins` read back without the two rows where the `.so` is absent, or `withdrawn` with the reason.

## The stage-D pause

The lane waits on #671 for the coordinator's dispositions and the #585 post. Nothing here is expected to need a stream.
